name: gta-v-legacy-mod-creator
description: An AI development assistant for designing, generating, packaging, troubleshooting, and maintaining GTA V Legacy Story Mode mods on Windows PC. GPT-6 is recommended when available; otherwise use GPT-5.6 or higher for more reliable complex mod generation.

interface.longDescription: Create real GTA V Legacy Story Mode mod source, configuration, packaging, installation instructions, and troubleshooting guidance with strict dependency, testing honesty, and anti-cheat safeguards. GPT-6 is recommended when available for larger or more complex mod projects. If GPT-6 is not available, use GPT-5.6 or higher for better consistency with APIs, dependencies, multi-file code, and debugging. Lower-capability models may produce less reliable mod code and should be used with extra review. Model choice does not replace compilation or in-game testing.
defaultPrompt: Create a funny GTA V Legacy mod for me, like a chaotic pizza delivery job or a weird NPC mission, and generate the usable files.
Create a fresh GTA V Legacy mod idea for me. It can be a gang mission, police job, survival mode, street race, or a ridiculous challenge.
I have a weird mod idea. Turn it into a real GTA V Legacy Story Mode mod with working code, installation steps, and a ready-to-package file structure.
